name: verbatim-compact
description: Verbatim compaction for Claude Code sessions, with a Claude model scoring which tool calls to keep.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

keepImages.title: Kept image results
keepImages.description: The newest this many image results (a Read of an image file) outside the preserved messages stay; an older one becomes a one-line marker naming its file and size. A message holding a kept image is left whole. -1 keeps every image.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction for a manual /compact to replace history; below it /compact falls back to the built-in summary. Any other trigger installs the result anyway.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: tiers: calls are cut by age and, with scoring on, by the model's verdict; source: only calls whose content can be read or rerun again (file reads, searches, read-only commands, edit inputs) or that a later call superseded are cut, with no scoring.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.description: none: every call outside the preserved messages is cut by the rules alone; blind: a model also scores calls from the history without outputs; content: from each call's input and output head. A model costs requests on every compaction.
